id: title:carlos-marchal-ph:feedback mode in the trace view

review.posthog_relevance: Adds backend ingestion and retrieval for user feedback on AI trace evaluations, including score and text, alongside frontend display and retry handling.
review.reason: The chunk P1.F12, P1.F13, P1.F17, P1.F20, P1.F25, P1.F58, P1.F59, and P1.F61 collectively demonstrate a substantive, bounded implementation of a feedback capability. P1.F12 and P1.F13 establish the backend API and database row model for storing feedback. P1.F17 and P1.F20 define the retrieval query and request parameters. P1.F25 and P1.F59 implement the client-side retrieval and UI
